content.short: Honey Finance enables NFT collectors to participate in multichain DeFi by using NFTs as collateral for loans and NFT farming.
content.description: Honey Finance lets users leverage their NFTs as collateral for peer-to-contract loans and participate in NFT farming. DAOs can deploy the protocol to build lending markets that connect lenders and borrowers within isolated risk markets, with interest rates that adjust according to liquidity. The platform targets a loan-to-value ratio of 50%, enabling borrowers to access up to half the NFT value. The governance token $HONEY can be minted by staking NFTs in its farms, giving participants a stake in governance and potential rewards.
